content: The link was copied incompletely. Copy the whole address, including the part after #, and open it again.

comment.text: Message shown in place of the content on the page of an external link of a private (end-to-end encrypted) room when the address lacks its secret part or the part is damaged. The secret is the text after the # character of the address, so the # sign stays as it is. Tells the visitor to copy the full address and open it again. Two full sentences with periods.
